title: Mila Victório Pessotto
text: Agronomist with a Ph.D. and international experience in applied research focused on sustainable cropping systems. Experienced in designing, conducting, and analyzing field and laboratory experiments in soil science, soil fertility and soil health, plant nutrition, cover crops, and nitrogen management in row crops. Skilled in experimental design, statistical analysis, data science, technical communication, and collaborating with universities, public institutions, farmers, and crop consultants to translate agronomic data into practical recommendations.
